meta.title: About — {brand}
meta.description: The story of {brand}: 5 passionate co-founders and 10 pioneer clubs building together the tool amateur football deserves.

hero.title: About — {brand}
hero.subtitle: 5 co-founders. 10 pioneer clubs. 1 conviction: amateur football deserves its own tool.

act1.title: The spark
act1.p0: It's 8:30 am on a cold Saturday morning in November. The pitch is soaked. Parents blow into their hands while the U11s warm up.
act1.p1: Romain is there, like every weekend. Phone in hand, he scrolls through three WhatsApp groups: 'Is the match still on?', 'My son can't make it', 'Which pitch is it again?'.
act1.p2: The coach is trying to figure out how many players he has for the 10 am match. He sent the call-ups on Tuesday evening by SMS. Three parents never replied. Two replied in the wrong group.
act1.p3: The president, meanwhile, is at home with a binder, a spreadsheet and a headache. 200 members. 16 teams. Unpaid dues to chase.
act1.p4: Everyone just copes — with makeshift tools, volunteer time and a mountain of goodwill. That Saturday, Romain thinks: 'There must be a better way.'

act2.title: 5 believers, one obvious call
act2.p0: The idea didn't come from an office. It came from the pitch. Romain talks to Jean. Jean knows the pain by heart. They bring in Jérémy, who knows dozens of clubs in the same situation.
act2.p1: Vanessa brings perspective: 'If we're going to do this, it has to genuinely serve people.' Damien joins: 'Clean code or it doesn't exist.' The math is simple.

act3.title: 10 clubs changed everything
act3.intro: Before writing a single line of code, we went out to listen. 10 partner clubs opened their doors, shared their pain, tested every screen, challenged every decision. Every feature was born from a real problem raised by a real club.
act3.heroQuote: SimplyFoot wasn't built in an office. It was built in 10 locker rooms.

0.text: We were losing 2 hours a week managing call-ups by SMS. Now, one click and everyone knows who's coming.
0.author: U15 coach, FC Gardanne

1.text: The hardest part was separated parents. Duplicates, confusion, messages lost. The linking code solved that in one move.
1.author: President, US Liffré

2.text: My 16 teams in a single app, with separate roles for each coach. I'm never going back.
2.author: President, Toulouse Rodéo

3.text: My treasurer thanked me for the first time in 10 years. That's when you know you did something right.
3.author: President, Stade Rennais B

act3.thanks: Thanks to our 10 pioneer clubs who are building SimplyFoot with us.

team.heading: The team behind SimplyFoot
team.intro: Five people, one shared conviction. No CEO, no hierarchy: 5 co-founders at the exact same rank.

romain.name: Romain Pennacchio
romain.spirit: The visionary. Passionate about football since childhood, he grew up in amateur clubs, between touchlines and locker rooms. The idea was born from his daily frustration.

jean.name: Jean Carboni
jean.spirit: The ground guy. He knows every reality of the amateur club — volunteers who give everything, coaches who sacrifice weekends, treasurers who work miracles with nothing.

jeremy.name: Jérémy Baruc
jeremy.spirit: The connector. He weaves links between people, ideas, clubs. His obsession: every user feels supported, never alone facing the tool.

vanessa.name: Vanessa Rolland
vanessa.spirit: Rigour and sensitivity. She knows that behind every registered player, there's a parent organising, driving, cheering in the rain. The product owes them too.

damien.name: Damien Alfaia
damien.spirit: The hands that build. Every screen, every interaction. His standard: the app must be as intuitive for a 60-year-old president as for a 16-year-old player.

lines.0: It's the 6-year-old kid touching their first ball.
lines.1: It's the volunteer coach preparing sessions after work.
lines.2: It's the president negotiating with the town hall to keep the pitch.
lines.3: It's the parent driving 45 minutes on a Sunday morning.
lines.4: It's the snack bar. The chips. The laughter. The arguments.

firstPerson.heading: We come from that world.
firstPerson.body: We don't observe amateur football from afar. We live it. We know it. We love it.
firstPerson.closing: That's why we built SimplyFoot. Not to disrupt a market. To serve a community.

act5.title: This is only the beginning

promises.0: Stay at the service of clubs. Not the other way around.
promises.2: Build with you. Not for you.

act5.signature: SimplyFoot: 5 believers and 10 pioneer clubs who said one Saturday morning — amateur football deserves better.

meta.title: Help center — {brand}
meta.description: Find answers to frequently asked questions about {brand}: sign-up, team management, call-ups, messaging and more.

FAQ.heading: Help center
FAQ.intro: Quickly find answers to the most common questions about {brand}. Still need help? Get in touch with our team.

create-account.question: How do I create my {brand} account?

answer.p0: Enter your email address and a password, then click “Sign up”. You can also sign up with your Google or Apple account.

google-login.question: Google sign-in isn't working — what should I do?

answer.p0: To sign up with Google, Chrome must be set as the default browser on your phone. If another browser is used (e.g. Opera or Samsung Internet), Google sign-in may fail. In that case, sign up the classic way with an email and password.

join-club.question: How do I join my club?

answer.p0: Once your account is created, you can join a club in three ways:
answer.l0: As a player or coach: enter the club code provided by the president (or by {brand} for pilot clubs).
answer.l1: As a legal guardian: enter your own details, then the team code provided by the coach, along with your child's information.

club-code.question: Where do I find the club code?

answer.p0: The club code is provided by the club president. For pilot clubs, this code is shared directly by the {brand} team.

team-code.question: Where do I find the team code?

answer.p0: The team code is shown on the team tag in the coach's dashboard. The coach can copy it in one click and send it to you.

multi-role.question: Can I be coach, player and parent at the same time?

answer.p0: Yes. {brand} supports multiple roles. You can be a coach, a player, the parent of a child player, and switch between your profiles in one click without signing out.

switch-profiles.question: How do I switch between my profiles?

answer.p0: At the top of the screen, next to your profile picture, tap the logo on the right. You'll see all your roles and can switch between them instantly.

edit-profile.question: How do I edit my personal information?

answer.p0: Tap the gear icon in the top right, then “Personal information”. You can update your name, date of birth, email, add a profile picture, or manage your child's profile.

change-password.question: How do I change my password?

answer.p0: Tap the gear icon in the top right, then “Change your password”.
In settings, tap “Manage your roles”. You can leave your current role at any time and join a new club with the matching club code.

deactivate-account.question: How do I deactivate my account?

answer.p0: Go to settings, then “Personal information”. At the bottom of this page you'll find the option to deactivate your account.

avoid-duplicates.question: We're separated parents — how do we avoid duplicates?

answer.p0: One parent signs the child up as usual. The coach then generates a link code specific to that child from their profile. This code is sent to the second parent, who during sign-up taps “Link a child” and enters the code. The second parent is automatically linked with no duplicate created.

share-credentials.question: Do we need to share an email or password?

answer.p0: No. Each parent has their own independent account. No credential sharing is required.

generate-link-code.question: Where does the coach generate the link code?

answer.p0: The coach opens the player's profile via the “Teams” tab, then taps on the player. A “Generate a code” button is available in the “Link code” section. This code is single-use.

create-team.question: How do I create a team?

answer.p0: From your dashboard, tap “Create a team”. Enter a name or nickname (Group 1, Team A…), select the category and gender, and confirm. A team code will be generated automatically.

share-team-code.question: How do I share the team code?

answer.p0: The team code appears on your team tag in the dashboard. Tap it to copy, then send it to the relevant players or parents.

second-coach.question: How do I join a team as a second coach?

answer.p0: Tap “Create a team”, then at the bottom of the screen select “Join a team as a coach”. Enter the team code provided by the main coach.

player-profiles.question: How do I access my players' profiles?

answer.p0: Tap the “Teams” tab, then the desired player. You'll see their personal information and the contact details of their legal guardians. Tapping the email opens a new email; tapping the phone number starts a call.

create-event.question: How do I create an event?

answer.p0: Tap the “+” button or “Create an event”. Enter the title, the team involved, the type of match, and the start and end date and time.

club-wide-event.question: How do I send an event to the whole club?

answer.p0: When creating it, select all teams in the club. The event will be sent to every member. Perfect for Christmas dinners, bingo nights, etc.

event-vs-callup.question: What's the difference between a regular event and a call-up?

answer.p0: If you tick the “Call-up” option, only the players you select will see this event and be able to take part. Without it (e.g. training sessions), the whole team sees the event.

recurring-training.question: How do I create a recurring training session?

answer.p0: Tick “Create a recurring event”. Choose the day and time slots (e.g. Tuesdays 5:30 pm to 7:30 pm) over a given period. An event will be created automatically every week.

edit-event.question: Can I edit an event after it's created?

answer.p0: Yes. Tap the event to open its details. You can change every field at any time: location, opponent, time, date, etc.

cancel-event.question: How do I cancel an event?

answer.p0: You can cancel an event at any time. Players will still see it, but with the “Cancelled” label clearly displayed.
Tap the attendance counter in the top right of the event. From that tab, select your players one by one or all at once, then confirm.

track-responses.question: How do I track players' responses?

answer.p0: In the attendance tab, you see the count (e.g. 12/14) and the indicator next to each player:
answer.l2: Small car icon = heading straight to the venue on their own

answer-for-player.question: A player doesn't have their phone — can I answer for them?

answer.p0: Yes. To the right of the search bar, tap the small pencil to switch to edit mode. You can then mark the player as present, absent, or indicate that they're heading straight to the venue.

car-icon.question: What does the “small car” icon mean?

answer.p0: It means the player (or their parent) is heading straight to the venue on their own, skipping the group meeting point. The coach knows not to wait for them at departure.

upcoming-events.question: How do I see upcoming events?

answer.p0: On your home page, you'll find the upcoming events along with your answer for each: present, absent, or not answered.

respond-to-callup.question: How do I respond to a call-up?

answer.p0: Tap the event, then at the bottom of the page, select “Present” or “Absent”. You can also specify whether you'll travel with the group or head straight to the venue.

edit-response.question: Can I change my response afterwards?

answer.p0: Yes, you can update your response at any time.
No, the Transport feature is not available yet. It will be added in a future update.
The calendar shows every day on which an event is scheduled. Tap a day to see the events, then tap an event to view its details.

calendar-all-roles.question: Does the calendar show events for all my roles?

answer.p0: Yes. If you are coach, player and parent at the same time, the calendar combines all your events in one place, regardless of the role involved.

bell.question: What is the bell at the top of the screen for?

answer.p0: The bell works like on Facebook. Every notification (call-up acceptance, event update, etc.) shows up there, in addition to the push notification on your phone.

coach-notifications.question: What notifications does a coach receive?

answer.p0: The coach gets a notification when a player accepts or declines a call-up.

player-notifications.question: What notifications does a player receive?

answer.p0: The player gets a notification when the coach creates, edits or cancels an event.
The inbox is next to the bell at the top of your screen. Tap the icon in the bottom right to start a new conversation.

coach-conversations.question: What conversations are available for a coach?

answer.l0: Club conversation — Chat with other coaches and the president.
answer.l1: Coaches — Send a private message to another coach in the club.
answer.l2: Teams — Chat with all players and parents of a team.

player-conversations.question: What conversations are available for a player?

answer.l0: Club conversation — Read-only mode (you can read the staff's messages).
answer.l1: Coaches — Send a private message to your team's coach(es).
answer.l2: Teams — Chat with all players and parents of your team.

messaging-identify.question: How do I know who I'm talking to in the inbox?

answer.p0: When you open a conversation, both the parent's name and the child's name are shown, so you clearly know who you're talking to. The same applies in group conversations.

messaging-photos.question: Can I send photos or videos?

answer.p0: No, sending photos and videos is not available yet in the inbox. This feature may be added in a future update.
The following features are under development and will be rolled out in upcoming releases:
answer.l2: Sending photos and videos in the inbox

answer.p0: Updates will be very frequent, with a planned cadence of roughly every two weeks.

faq.heading: All answers before you start
faq.intro: The questions we get the most about pricing and revenue sharing.

whichPlan.question: Which plan fits my club?
whichPlan.answer: If you're just trying SimplyFoot with a single team, start on DISCOVERY (free). If you're a structured club that wants to use the app across all teams and collect ticketing revenue, go STARTER. For a mature club with several sections needing season passes, FEC export and Customer Success, choose CLUB.

takeRate.question: How does SimplyFoot pay back my club?
takeRate.answer: On every revenue your club generates via SimplyFoot, you keep the bulk: 88 % on STARTER, 90 % on CLUB. We take a small commission on the transactional layer; the rest is wired to you automatically, no action required.

modules.question: Which add-on modules are available?
modules.answer: Three modules can be added to the STARTER plan: Digital canteen (+€19 / month), Tournaments (+€15 / month), Club shop (+€25 / month). All three come included with CLUB.

canChangePlan.question: Can I change plan during the year?
canChangePlan.answer: Yes, anytime. Upgrading DISCOVERY → STARTER or STARTER → CLUB is instant, with prorated adjustment. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current period.

clubGrows.question: What if my club grows and crosses a size tier?
clubGrows.answer: The size tier (Small / Medium / Large) only affects price. As soon as you cross the player threshold, we move you to the next tier with a prorated adjustment. No outage, no surprise.

engagement.question: Is there a commitment?
engagement.answer: No imposed commitment. The monthly plan is cancellable in one click. The yearly plan (with a 17 % discount, roughly 2 months free) covers 12 months but is refundable on a prorated basis if the club stops operating.

paymentMethods.question: How does payment work?
paymentMethods.answer: Credit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) or SEPA direct debit, via Stripe or Mangopay. Billing starts only after the 30-day free trial — you only enter payment details when you decide to continue.

billing.question: Who receives the invoice and the revenue share?
billing.answer: The subscription invoice is issued in the club's name (French non-profit association or equivalent structure) and emailed to the treasurer. Ticketing revenue is transferred to the club's bank account on the chosen schedule (weekly or monthly). All documents are downloadable as PDF from your dashboard.

freeTrial.question: How does the free trial work?
freeTrial.answer: 30 days of full access to SimplyFoot, no credit card required at sign-up. Set up your club, invite coaches and players, test in real conditions. At the end of the trial, you freely decide whether to continue — no automatic charge.

human.heading: Because a club is far more than management.

simo.title: SIMO, your companion
simo.body: He welcomes, guides, celebrates. He walks with every member and makes the app more alive than a spreadsheet.

passport.title: The player passport
passport.body: A clear, proud sport identity: seasons, stats, history, club — everything that tells an amateur's journey.

card.title: The evolving card
card.body: Physical or digital, it grows with the player. Collection, badges, rarity — the pride of the club's colours.

human.closing: A club is organisation. But it's also pride, belonging and memories. SimplyFoot honours both.

innovation.heading: What if your club could generate new revenue in 2026?
innovation.subtitle: We are preparing something that will change amateur football finances. Reserved first for clubs already signed up on SimplyFoot.
innovation.body: For decades, amateur clubs have relied on dues, the canteen and the tombola. The world has changed. So have the possibilities. We are working on a system designed for your members, supporters and local community — turning club attachment into concrete resources. More on that very soon.

faqSection.heading: Questions we often get.
faqSection.intro: Defuse the classic objections — no corporate speak.

price.question: How much does it cost the club?
price.answer: Affordable for every non-profit budget. Pricing scales with member count: the smallest clubs start at a few euros per month. Contact us for a dedicated quote.

seniors.question: Will our 65-year-old board members find their way around?
seniors.answer: SimplyFoot is designed to be simple at any age. Large buttons, clear labels, short flows. Video tutorials and human support for every club.

data.question: What about our data?
data.answer: Your data stays yours. French hosting, GDPR, no resale, no ads. You can export at any time.

migration.question: If we migrate from another tool, how does it go?
migration.answer: We walk you through importing members and calendar. The switch takes one to two sessions depending on club size.

offline.question: Does the app work offline?
offline.answer: The essentials stay accessible with a weak network — useful on remote pitches.

idea.question: What if we have a feature idea?
idea.answer: It can happen. Our pilot clubs shape the roadmap directly. Write to us.

revenue.question: What exactly is this innovation for club revenue?
revenue.answer: A major feature coming soon. Sign up on the priority list to be notified first.

pilote.question: How do I join the pilot program?
pilote.answer: The pilot program welcomes 10 founding partner clubs. We have a 30-minute chat to check the fit, you get free app access, and we build the product around your feedback. Apply via the form by selecting “Join the pilot program”.

compat.question: Does SimplyFoot work for a club of 50 members?
compat.answer: Yes — the tool is built for every amateur club, from the village team to the city giant. The DISCOVERY plan is free up to 50 members and includes the essential features. You upgrade only when you actually need to.

delay.question: How long until I can get a demo?
delay.answer: We'll offer you a slot within two business days. The demo lasts 30 minutes over video, with no commitment. You walk away with a sandbox account to share with your team.
